The Skill requires post-analysis saved-JSON reading and a Markdown summary with tables, trends and recommendations in results/summaries/. No executable successor, file association, exact summary input projection or writer is supplied. EM01–EM04 and EM10 retain possible observation of the whole parsed version acquired for that purpose, without exposing internal text by implication or making all fields necessary. The automatic-save obligation coexists with executable guards, child save suppression and the empty bulk bypass.

Protected progress logging sends the current input URL to console before publish. The normal projection uses a clock sample only for falsy notification time. The case summary retains delivery and actual caught values but does not separately bind that sample or distinguish rejected publish from receipt followed by a protected exception. A failed row does not establish remote non-effect.

The normal child projection has a clock acquisition only when latestUpdate.notifyTime is falsy. The compact projection does not separately bind that conditional sample. The exceptional delivery case retains the attempted request but does not distinguish rejection from an acquired response followed by a projection exception; neither establishes eventual index state.

Protected progress logging sends the current input URL to console before inspection. The post-attempt case retains actual URL/site delivery and caught exception but does not distinguish rejected inspection from receipt followed by a protected exception. An error row's indexed:false is distinct from a successful non-PASS verdict.

The second-resolution filename and sanitized labels allow path collisions. Internal saver deliveries summarize the same conditional directory creation, timestamp, metadata wrapper and persistent replace at each call; the payload or returned path is not the serialized content. The supplied write has no file-content output.

The config call may read the default .env under initialization cwd and populate environment bindings. Its JavaScript return is discarded; the subsequent post-state is distinct. The source does not establish identity with the documented project root, exact merge outcomes, or an unconditional environment replacement.
